attributes.action: Ban use of Phone Blocking pouches in all schools across the UK please :)
attributes.additional_details: This would prevent students having to ask teachers questions in lesson e.g. French you only need a single word translated or your friend is in another form and lost their timetable and needs to ask you what lesson you have or can check themself etc.
attributes.background: I understand the use of phone blocking pouches but it makes it alot harder to communicate with friends in other classes during break/lunch

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Allow phones in schools" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777706
